ideas.title: Following the Money in Child Care Fraud
ideas.description: An investigation into the financial transactions and funding sources of child care providers in Minnesota to identify potential fraud and corruption.
questions: What are the sources of funding for child care providers in Minnesota?
Are there any suspicious financial transactions or patterns of behavior?
ideas.insight: By following the money and analyzing financial transactions, we may be able to identify potential fraud and corruption in the child care system. This investigation could lead to a larger expose on the issue and potentially prevent further fraud and corruption.
